item.title: The Senate passes the Protect College Sports Act, but the bill's future is unclear
item.description: The bill's supporters, which include the NCAA, say it will tame what they call a "Wild West" era of college sports as litigation chips away at long-held rules around eligibility, transfers and pay.

item.title: Kyle MacLachlan says he was David Lynch's 'submersible' into dark places
item.description: MacLachlan was 23 when he auditioned for Lynch's adaptation of Dune. The two would go on to work together on the cult classics Blue Velvet and Twin Peaks. MacLachlan's new memoir is Fictional Selves.

item.title: I didn't think 'Pachinko' could be topped. Then I read 'American Hagwon'
item.description: Min Jin Lee's new novel is the third in a planned four-novel series about the Korean diaspora. Nearly 10 years in the making, this sweeping-but-intimate 600+ page book is overwhelming — in a good way.

item.title: Prosecutors are reopening a Cornell fraternity rape case. Here's what we know
item.description: New York prosecutors are reopening an investigation into an alleged rape case at Cornell University in 2024. The alleged victim recently filed a lawsuit against seven members of Chi Phi fraternity.

item.title: Trump's immigration push has largely spared farms. Idaho dairymen worry it won't last.
item.description: America's farms have largely escaped the president's aggressive immigration crackdown. But as ICE sweeps continue across the nation, farmers are uneasy because many still can't find enough workers.

item.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
item.description: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

item.title: SpaceX's Starship launches on first orbital mission from Texas
item.description: Starship is key to SpaceX's commercial success and NASA's plans to land humans on the moon. This is the 14th flight of the uncrewed Starship, but the first time it reached orbit.

item.title: Trump aims to leave a physical legacy in D.C., bulldozing norms along the way
item.description: President Trump has brought his New York real estate background to the White House. But experts say D.C. is a very different historic and legal landscape — and worry about the precedent he could set.

item.title: 'End Times Fascism' looks at supremacist groups uniting around end-of-the-world ideas
item.description: Authors Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor identify supremacists that have, despite ideological differences, converged around the conviction that they are part of an elite destined to survive an apocalypse.
